title: cyclosorus philippinarum
intro: Cyclosorus philippinarum, commonly known as Philippine fern, is a type of fern species that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, where it is used to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Cyclosorus philippinarum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
